recurring_failure_modes: Small move-ordering and terminal-scoring heuristics remained statistically neutral.
Broad PSQT retraining improved shallow fit but regressed complete-search teacher alignment.
Spending more time or nodes without a structural efficiency gain was neutral or negative.
The only accepted post-exp-0039 change was a tightly scoped hard-position pairwise evaluator adjustment.
exhausted_ideas: broad fresh-cycle or rehearsal PSQT retraining
time-budget increases without a search change

ranked_next_hypotheses.title: Depth-aware transposition-table score reuse
ranked_next_hypotheses.mechanism: Store depth in a position-keyed entry and permit bound cutoffs only when the stored depth is at least the requested depth, with depth-preferring replacement.
ranked_next_hypotheses.scope: Search-only; no evaluator or move-generation change.
ranked_next_hypotheses.pre_arena_gate: Verify deeper-to-shallower reuse, unchanged protected tests, legal moves, zero stress failures, and no fixed-position regression before the paired arena.
ranked_next_hypotheses.risk: Incorrect bound or replacement semantics could create unstable scores or invalid cutoffs.

ranked_next_hypotheses.title: Static-exchange evaluation for captures
ranked_next_hypotheses.mechanism: Order captures by exchange outcome and initially prune only strictly losing quiescence captures.
ranked_next_hypotheses.scope: Capture ordering and quiescence only; no retraining.
ranked_next_hypotheses.pre_arena_gate: Hand-verified exchange positions, tactical solve non-regression, and measured quiescence-node reduction.
ranked_next_hypotheses.risk: Pins, x-rays, promotions and en-passant handling can make an incorrect implementation tactically unsound.

ranked_next_hypotheses.title: Frozen-base king-safety feature block
ranked_next_hypotheses.mechanism: Freeze the accepted 770 weights and fit only a minimal set of king-zone, pawn-shield and open-file features on hard positions.
ranked_next_hypotheses.scope: Small evaluator extension plus constrained offline training.
ranked_next_hypotheses.pre_arena_gate: Held-out full-search alignment improvement on king-attack positions with under five percent NPS loss and no global alignment regression.
ranked_next_hypotheses.risk: Feature cost or coarse linear terms may erase the positional gain.

selection_reason: It is structurally distinct from the rejected TT move cache, localized enough for causal evaluation, and can be validated with a direct reuse mechanism test before arena expenditure.
